Subject: Recap: Redwood x SaaSCo — procurement path & next steps

Hi Emily / SaaSCo procurement team,

Thanks again for taking the call today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment on the commercial path and what would unblock a December pilot: 

- Outcome of call: SaaSCo is excited to run a 6-week pilot but procurement needs clarity on the invoice/PO route and any marketplace option.
- What Redwood delivered: SOW draft (attached), SOC2 redacted, standard T&Cs reference link.

As discussed, can you confirm the preferred payment route:
1) Purchase Order + invoice (standard for enterprise)
2) Corporate card (short-term pilot, but finance constrains)
3) Cloud marketplace (AWS/GCP) — if you need marketplace listing we can prioritize but it adds ~2-3 weeks.

Please also confirm: billing remit (legal name + remit address), procurement contact for PO, and whether IT needs any additional compliance artifacts beyond the SOC2 we attached. If PO, please send your PO template or a sample so our finance team can pre-fill.

Proposed owners / timeline:
- SaaSCo procurement owner: Emily (please confirm)
- Redwood commercial owner: Olga (me) / Rafael (finance)
- Target start: week of 2026-12-20 pending PO or card
\Next steps: 1) Emily confirms preferred route and shares PO template by EOD 2026-12-03; 2) Redwood returns populated PO / final SOW within 48 hours; 3) Weekly check-ins until executed.

Attachments: SOW_v1.pdf, SOC2-redacted.pdf

Thanks — I’ll do a short weekly nudge if we don’t see the PO come through.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.inference
+1 (415) 555-0134
